exported_guarantees.statement: Trust, affinity and fear are directed stances; changing A→B does not mirror or mutate B→A.
Material relationship differences can change an explainable action, target or opportunity choice rather than only dialogue flavour.
Relationship consumers are action-specific; there is no universal sign/formula across all actions.
PA-03 owns current causal relationship state and bounded provenance, not unbounded relationship biography.
exported_guarantees.source_pointer: PA-03 / Current relationship state vs biography

exported_guarantees.statement: PA-03 preserves PA-02 bounded discovery by rejecting default global/N-hop social traversal for target discovery.

exclusions_nonclaims.statement: A universal friendship/opinion scalar as canonical social state is rejected.
Implicit symmetry for actor stance is rejected.
Unbounded relationship biography inside every edge is rejected.
Default global/N-hop social traversal is rejected because it violates inherited PA-02 bounded-discovery intent.
Respect, loyalty, attraction, jealousy and other dimensions remain LATER until a concrete behavior needs them.

reopen_conditions: Concrete counterexample shows the accepted directed/action-specific semantics are false or inapplicable.
A later accepted behavior cannot be expressed cleanly by adopted dimensions/roles/obligations and therefore justifies reopening a LATER dimension.
escalate_if: A consumer needs exact relationship semantics beyond the exported invariants/status table.
A relationship disposition would be reclassified, especially LATER/REJECT.
A consumer proposes mirrored stance, global/N-hop target discovery, or another contradiction with inherited PA-02.
Live accepted identity/source bytes contradict the capsule.

dispositions.source_key: continuous/banded influences within an eligible set
sourced active reason references for current relationship state
respect, loyalty, attraction, jealousy or additional affect dimensions
universal friendship/opinion scalar as canonical social state
permanent favour/debt tags with no identity/lifecycle
unbounded relationship biography stored inside every edge
default global/N-hop social traversal to discover targets
